questions.question: PR #1095 is green and all threads are resolved, but d24caddb9 is unreviewed and the trace lacks its review: block. How do you want to close it out?

options.label: Review round 3, then close (Recommended)
options.description: Run /rvw-pr 1095 on d24caddb9. If it finds nothing, add the ship-report review: block to the trace, push, and it is ready for you to merge. If it finds something, /fix-pr again.

options.label: Skip review, add the block now
